output.one_liner: PostHog is an open-source platform for building self-driving products with AI-powered analytics, session replay, feature flags, and more.
output.description: PostHog provides a comprehensive suite of developer tools including product analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and AI observability. It captures product data to proactively diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and generate pull requests. The platform is designed to help teams build self-driving products by automating insights and improvements.

icp.who: Product managers and engineering teams at tech companies
icp.pain: Manual analysis of user behavior and product performance is time-consuming and reactive.
icp.buying_trigger: Need to automate product insights and improve user experience without manual data analysis.

differentiators: Self-driving mode that generates pull requests
Generous free tier covering 97% of companies
proof_points: 97% of companies use PostHog for free (from pricing page)
"Join 500,000+ teams already shipping with PostHog" (from homepage)
output.pricing_current: Usage-based pricing with generous free tiers: 1M events, 5K recordings, 1M flag requests, 100K exceptions, 1500 survey responses monthly. Paid usage starts at $0.00005/event, $0.005/recording, $0.0001/request.

voice.sample_phrase: PostHog automatically diagnoses problems, fixes bugs, and generates pull request you review and merge.

gaps: No direct demo video embedded on homepage
No explicit user count or growth metrics provided
No third-party review scores (e.g., G2, Capterra) displayed

confidence.notes: High confidence due to comprehensive documentation, active GitHub repository, and transparent pricing.
